name: ARHT Media Inc.
summary: ARHT Media Inc., along with its affiliated companies, specializes in creating, manufacturing, and deploying digital human holograms and associated content across the globe. Leveraging its proprietary, patented technology, the company facilitates the live capture, streaming, and projection of these virtual human representations for real-time, two-way interactions with both physical and remote audiences. Established in 2012, the company maintains its headquarters in Toronto, Canada.
